# Bootstrap distribution - proof of concept

Bootstrap distribution of DMS-traine model on the LGK test set:

```{r}
# how to use boot library: https://www.statmethods.net/advstats/bootstrapping.html
informedness <- function(x, i) {
	bmi(x[i,], obs=true, pred=pred)$bmi
}

data <- read.csv("../train-on-DMS/results-LGK_dupl.v1.test.csv")

data_train <- read.csv("../train-on-DMS/results-LGK_dupl_bymut.v1.train.csv")
data_train$pred <- round(data_train$pred_avg) # average voting
```

With ensemble average voting:

```{r}
data$pred <- round(data$pred_avg)
bootstrap_avg <- boot(data, statistic=informedness, R=5000)
bootstrap_avg
```

With ensemble majority voting: *slightly, insignificantly better*

```{r}
data$pred <- round(data$pred_maj)
bootstrap_maj <- boot(data, statistic=informedness, R=5000)
bootstrap_maj
```

```{r}
boot(data_train, statistic=informedness, R=100)
```

# Bootstrap all the models

```{r load-data}
# all examined models
MODELS = strsplit(
"train-on-DMS
 train-on-LGK-dupl
 train-on-LGK-GFP
 train-on-PKS
 train-on-TEM-v22
 train-on-DMS-leave-LGK
 train-on-DMS-leave-PKS
 train-on-DMS-leave-TEM
 fine-tuned-TEM
 fine-tuned-PKS
 fine-tuned-DMS
 train-bypos-on-LGK-dupl
 train-bypos-on-PKS
 train-bypos-on-TEM
", '\\s+')

models = c()
paths = c()
sets = c()
for(model in MODELS[[1]]) {
	evals <- list.files(path=paste0("../", model), pattern='*.test.csv')
	sets <- c(sets, evals)
	models <- c(models, rep(model, length(evals))) # repeat
	
	paths <- c(paths, list.files(path=paste0("../", model), pattern='*.test.csv', full.name=TRUE))
}

# remove results- prefix and .csv suffix
sets <- gsub("^results-|.csv$", "", sets)

# load all raw predictions
datas <- lapply(paths, read.csv, header=TRUE)
```

## Bootstrap all the data

```{r bootstrap}
bootstrap_CI <- function(data) {
	data$pred <- round(data$pred_avg)
	suppressWarnings(
		data %>%
			boot(statistic=informedness, R=1000) %>%
			boot.ci()
	)
}

CIs <- lapply(datas, bootstrap_CI)
```

Construct table of confidence intervals (as 95% percentile):

```{r CIs}
eval_table <- data.frame(
	model = models,
	dataset = sets,
	CI_min = sapply(CIs, \(x) x$percent[4]),
	informedness = sapply(CIs, \(x) x$t0),
	CI_max = sapply(CIs, \(x) x$percent[5])
)

CI_min_table <- eval_table %>%
	pivot_wider(id_cols=model, names_from=dataset, values_from=CI_min)
CI_max_table <- eval_table %>%
	pivot_wider(id_cols=model, names_from=dataset, values_from=CI_max)
inform_table <- eval_table %>%
	pivot_wider(id_cols=model, names_from=dataset, values_from=informedness)
```

Sparklines with confidence intervals.

```{r echo=FALSE}
# based on https://glin.github.io/reactable/articles/cookbook/cookbook.html#bar-charts
library(htmltools)
library(reactable)

sparkline_bar <- function(label, low, upp, height = "1.5rem", fill = "#00bfc4", background = NULL) {
	left <- max(low, 0)
	# show at least minimal CI bar	
	diff = upp-low
	MIN_CI <- 1
	if(diff < MIN_CI) {
		low <- low - (MIN_CI - diff)/2
		diff <- MIN_CI
	}
	
	CI <- div(style = list(background = fill, left=paste0(left, '%'), width = paste0(upp-left, '%'), height = '100%', position='absolute'))
	if(low < 0) {
		low = -low
		fill = "red"
	}
	bar <- div(style = list(background = fill, width = paste0(low, '%'), height = '100%', opacity=0.5, position='absolute'))
	
	chart <- div(style = list(flexGrow = 1, background = background, height = height, width = '100%', position="absolute"), CI, bar)
	label <- span(style = list(position = "relative", left="1%"), label)
	div(style = list(display = "flex", alignItems = "center", position="relative"), chart, label)
}

```

### Bootstrap results

Showing `informedness (confidence interval)` table model vs. evaluation set:

```{r print-results, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
get_column <- function(name) {
	colDef(align = "left", cell = function(value, index) {
      min <- CI_min_table[index,][[name]] * 100
      max <- CI_max_table[index,][[name]] * 100
      label = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", value * 100, min, max)
      if(!is.na(min))
    	sparkline_bar(label, min, max)
    })
}
columns <- lapply(names(inform_table), get_column)
names(columns) <- names(inform_table)
columns <- columns[2:length(columns)]

reactable(
  inform_table,
  columns = columns,
  pagination = FALSE
)
```
